review_description: Thank you Omzen electric. Their prices were competitive and used products that were well reviewed and trusted. Justin was friendly and professional, and was happy to accommodate all inquiries, allowing you to tailor make your solar setup down to the smallest detail. He was also realistic about what we needed, and didn't try to up-sell products we didn't necessarily need. Installation was booked in literally on the day the VicSolar rebate came through. Nathan and his crew did a such great job with the panel and inverter installation that the independent inspector remarked how easy it was to inspect. A few roof tiles were cracked in the process but the guys came back to fix it up within a week. Good idea to have spare roof tiles easily available and not hide them away like I did.

A couple of iterative quotes and some real value add suggestions that other company's just didn't think of.Made for a bigger system (13.3kW) that looks great - so partner is happy!Once we'd made the decision, system was installed within 2 weeks.Very professional team doing the install, 4-5 on site at any point.  Quick, clean and made good all finishes - even arranged to source replacement roof titles cracked.highly recommend - they're already doing a colleagues house and his next door too!
